row.title: READ-BUDGET-10: three unindexed D1 readers held the tick lean
row.body: The org D1 read 175k rows an hour against the 120k cap, so every tick skipped dispatch and execute and issues sat open. Top readers by rows read (d1QueriesAdaptiveGroups): kg_nodes by changed_at (115k), outcomes by result and time (100k), dispatches by status and time (13k). Migration 0034 indexes all three. The cap is not raised. Separate open loop: the Actions executor's model rungs fail (GitHub Models answers 200 OK text, Workers AI via the site Worker returns 502).
